fusions.name: Skipped Sinker
fusions.desc: Skips a cast sinker that deals 7 water damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unruffled Plunge
fusions.desc: Drops your full plated weight and throws up a wave, dealing 28 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Beads Off Oiled Steel
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Preening Between Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
